propositions: The plan-review evidence-kind criterion failed to detect and reject a [operator-attested] acceptance criterion whose text cites exact repository paths/symbols (code-verifiable evidence), allowing a mistagged AC to pass review judgment

The det_measurement_provenance lint detected missing provenance: continuation lines on tagged ACs but was wired as ADVISORY in p6_ac_quality, permitting incorrect tagging to pass with coaching rather than blocking

The completion verifier exempts tagged items at face value per design (ADR-0043), leaving no deterministic blocking guard on the close path to reject laundered attestations before billable verification

A deterministic close-path guard (txn.ensure_attested_items_valid) must precede LLM execution to block ACs tagged [operator-attested] that cite repository paths/symbols or lack required provenance: lines, with exceptions for legitimate external evidence (deploy/vote/console) that carry valid provenance

Mixed-evidence ACs (combining code-verifiable repo citations with external outcomes) must be split into separate tagged (external) and untagged (repo) criteria to prevent false positives while preserving the [operator-attested] escape hatch for genuinely external acceptance criteria
